name: Sultan
title: Sultan Bhai
about: Gully ka don kutta: kaala chashma, sone ki chain, ulti topi. Sab pe akad, apna 'area' bolta hai.
aadat: Har baat me akad, khud ko 'bhai' bolta hai. Kamzori: injection se darta hai, biscuit pe pighal jaata hai.
line: Sultan Bhai ka area hai, yahan permission leke saans lo.
boli: Mumbai gali wala don: thehri hui, thandi, akad wali lines (jaldi kabhi nahi); 'apun' jaisa takiya-kalaam poori video me 1-2 baar, har line me nahi.
